create.title: Odd-lift parity and corrected reciprocal resonance in the top M2 energy
create.statement_tex: In the positive-offset part of the accepted transposed-row energy, write h=ga and h+2r=gb with (a,b)=1. Then g,a,b are odd, r=g(b-a)/2, and at a negative m-Poisson stationary mode k the complete character-phase factor is (-1)^((b-a)/2)e(-gX(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))^2/(4k)). Consecutive admissible lifts differ by two, so the exact lift ratio is e(-X(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))^2/(2k)); a step-two Abel bound is governed by ||2alpha||=||X(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))^2/(2k)||, not ||alpha||. A fixed primal collar at m=ceil(gb/4) and m=ga has O(L^2 X^epsilon) capacity and removes the ceiling parity from the interior. If the sharp endpoint is left inside the transform, ceil(gb/4)=gb/4+1/2+chi_4(gb)/4 forces a mod-four split and the conservative distance ||4alpha||. For X=T^4, odd 13|T, (a,b)=(81,121), and k=2T^2/13, the saddle x*/g=169/4 is strictly interior, alpha=10-13T^2/2 is half-integral, and the two actual W-profile arguments 9/13 and 11/13 both have weight one. Thus the offset character gives no liftwise alternation and the criterion ||alpha|| >> G^(-1) cannot discard the resonant union. This obstruction proves no energy estimate.

update.next_action: Remove fixed primal endpoint collars, certify the complete actual-symbol centred-integral and step-two variation theorem, and bound the corrected ||X(sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))^2/(2k)|| resonance union. The offset character is constant along odd gcd lifts.
Use the exact finite energy as the antecedent. Any m-Poisson attack must use the odd-lift ratio and retain the corrected reciprocal resonance; do not infer character cancellation along gcd lifts.

Treat radial Poisson as an exact representation only: the reciprocal k-process returns to the original m-phase. A new estimate must act jointly on the primitive-pair and reciprocal-mode resonance union.

The hard top block remains the exact transposed-row energy. Correct its odd-lift resonance interface and bound the weighted primitive-pair/reciprocal-mode survivor; smooth packets and other M2 ranges remain separately owned.

reject.reason: All admissible gcd lifts are odd, so consecutive lifts differ by two. The geometric denominator is governed by ||2alpha||, and exact half-integer alpha families are fully coherent although ||alpha||=1/2.
With r=g(b-a)/2 and odd g, (-1)^r=(-1)^((b-a)/2) is constant on a primitive lift ray. It supplies no liftwise alternation.

The exact ceiling ceil(gb/4)=gb/4+1/2+chi_4(gb)/4 has a mod-four component. Step two is structurally valid only after the target-safe primal endpoint collar is removed; otherwise a step-four split is required.

The gcd-lift phase is linear in the radial lift. Transforming the reciprocal variable back restores the original m-phase with cancelling Gaussian units and reciprocal Jacobians, so the operation is a self-return.

The exact fourth-power family proves phase coherence and has both W-profile factors equal to one, but the remaining Vaaler/support weights and cancellation across primitive pairs and reciprocal modes are not controlled. It is a route falsifier, not a lower bound for the complete signed energy.
